Description
1 Kilo Asahi Silver Bar
From the legacy of Johnson Matthey emerges the Asahi Silver bar, crafted by the renowned Asahi Refining. A perfect blend of tradition and modernity, these 1 kilo bars embodies the art of precious metals refining.
There are a few different designs of these 1 kilo silver bars depending on which year they were minted. We will randomly pick one.
Bar Highlights:
Contains a substantial 1 Kilo of .999 fine Silver.
Securely packaged in a protective cardboard box for pristine preservation.
Distinctively poured, giving it a unique texture and feel.
Fully eligible for Precious Metals IRAs.
Front: Embellished with the Asahi Refining SLC mark, denoting its weight and unmatched purity.
Back: Sleek and smooth, kept intentionally unadorned.
A testament to its authenticity, guaranteed by Asahi Refining.
With a lineage tracing back to the iconic Johnson Matthey, Asahi Refining took the helm in 2015, maintaining the high standards and craftsmanship that the industry reveres. Asahi, originating from Tokyo in 1952, brought with it a rich history of precious metals recycling.
This 1 kilo Asahi Silver bar, though reminiscent of the classic Johnson Matthey design, is a fresh offering from Asahi Refining, marking a new era in the precious metals market. A sound investment opportunity, this bar is offered at a competitive premium, making it an ideal choice for those wishing to amplify their silver portfolio in one purchase.
Only at Bullion Trading LLC can you secure this blend of history and modern refining. Add this 1 kilo Asahi Silver Bar to your collection today, and be a part of the evolving world of precious metals.
